title: Program simulation states
statement: Given sets $\Lambda$ and $SD$ and a nonnegative integer $m$, define the program simulation states to be the states of five forms: a program state labelled by an element of $\Lambda$; a decider simulation state carrying a program label, a decider state, an index in $\{0,\ldots,m\}$, two Boolean flags, and an optional Boolean result; two return states, each carrying a program label, such an index, and two Boolean flags; and a register return state carrying the same data as a return state together with a register index in $\{0,\ldots,m-1\}$ and a Boolean scan flag.
